title: Food in the ventral visual stream
paper: Khosla, Ratan Murty and Kanwisher 2022, Current Biology

steps.title: Known categories first
steps.paper: Before reporting food, the decomposition of responses in the Natural Scenes Dataset had to recover the known components for faces, places, bodies and words.
steps.here: A known effect on this pipeline: busts against vases of the same height.

steps.title: Food against matched objects
steps.paper: The food component responded more to images of food than to other objects.
steps.here: Twenty foods against objects of the same colour, each on the same counter, framed to the same size.

steps.title: Swap the item, watch the brain
steps.paper: Each image is one condition; the response is read per image.
steps.here: The agent changes the item control. Isaac renders it and TRIBE reads it, beside the world.

steps.title: Shape as the alternative
steps.paper: Colour, shape and texture were tested as alternative explanations and did not account for the food response.
steps.here: The same foods against objects of the same shape.

steps.title: Greyscale
steps.paper: The food response held when the images were shown in greyscale.
steps.here: The colour-matched set again, rendered with the colour control set to greyscale.

bindings.b: an object of the same colour

steps.title: The item without its scene
steps.paper: The images were natural photographs, so every food was seen in its own scene.
steps.here: The agent sets the Focus control to the item only; the counter and board become grey, and TRIBE reads the item alone.

steps.title: Weigh the evidence
steps.paper: The conclusion rests on the effect surviving every control.
steps.here: Every run from this template side by side, as a share of this project's effect.
